title: Forest Ecosystem Management, B.S. — Forest Biology Option (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: Pre-2026 curriculum, built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's own 'Suggested Academic Plan' PDF and 'Program Requirements' tab (cross-checked against each other; the plan PDF's own printed semester subtotals -- 15-17/16-17/14/16/16.5/14.5-15.5/15/12-15 -- sum to its own printed 'Total Credits 119-126', confirming internal consistency). The major itself was named 'Forest Ecosystem Management, B.S.' (not 'Forest Ecosystems, B.S.') through the 2025-26 catalog; it was renamed for 2026-27 (see FORES-2026.json), at which point its four options were also renamed (Forest Biology -> Biodiversity and Conservation; Forest Management unchanged; Community and Urban Forest Management -> Forests, Trees, and People; Watershed Management -> Watershed Ecohydrology). This file builds the Forest Biology option -- confirmed, course-for-course and credit-for-credit, to be the same option FORES-2026.json actually builds under its new 'Biodiversity and Conservation' name (same FOR 200/203/255/266/308/204/350/409/410/421/430/450W/HORT 445/WFS 209N/CHEM 202/SOILS 101-102/BIOL 110-220W/ENT 313-FOR 403-PPEM 318 pool split 2+2 across two semesters, same MATH 140-or-110 and STAT 200/240/250 placement, same 'Supporting Course' and 'Elective' generic pools), so this year's file mirrors FORES-2026.json's exact semester structure -- including its post-scraper-fix MATH 3/MATH 4/MATH 21/MATH 22 prereq-chain additions for CHEM 110 and STAT 200/240/250, which are course-catalog facts (Backend/catalogs/, shared across catalog years, not scraped per-year) rather than degree-plan facts, so they apply identically here. Course-list differences actually found for 2022 specifically: none against 2023-2025 archives; FOR 204 was still titled 'Dendrology' in 2022-23 (renamed 'Silvics and Forest Dynamics' starting 2023-24 per the 2023 archive, same course number and 2 credits both years -- informational only, doesn't change the plan). Same-page notes for this year: 'Begin Campus: Any Penn State Campus, End Campus: University Park' (identical wording to 2026's own live page), and the 'Where can I complete this program?' tile on the PSU /programs/ search page lists only 'Campus: University Park' for this major both now and historically -- confirmed single-campus, no Erie/Behrend or Brandywine offering exists for this major in any catalog year checked. FOR 410 and FOR 450W still carry the same unenforceable meta-prereqs noted in FORES-2026.json's notes. Entrance-to-major requirement (2.00 cumulative GPA + third-semester standing) is unchanged from 2026's; no min_gpa field needed, consistent with FORES-2026.json's own omission of one.
